expectations.text: Output offers multiple metric options rather than committing to one
expectations.evidence: Output presents OPTION A (User Activation), OPTION B (Purchase/Conversion), OPTION C (Retention/Engagement), and OPTION D (Revenue/Monetization) with distinct metric frameworks for each goal.

expectations.text: Output lists what must be confirmed before metrics can be locked
expectations.evidence: Section 'Before Sample Size Estimation Can Proceed' lists 7 required confirmations: (1) Primary metric choice, (2) Minimum meaningful effect, (3) Statistical confidence target, (4) Guardrail thresholds, (5) Success/failure decision rules, (6) Duration estimate, (7) Relevant segments. Also 'Critical Missing Context' section details 5 questions that must be answered.

expectations.text: Output does NOT present a single metric as definitively correct
expectations.evidence: Output explicitly states 'choose the appropriate framework below' (line 51, conditional language), 'All metric choices above are conditional' (line 269), and 'This framework is entirely provisional due to missing context' (line 268). No metric is presented as the correct choice.

expectations.text: Output identifies at least 3 different possible goals/contexts
expectations.evidence: Output identifies four distinct goal contexts: OPTION A (User Activation), OPTION B (Purchase/Conversion), OPTION C (Retention/Engagement), and OPTION D (Revenue/Monetization), with tailored metrics for each.

expectations.text: Output explicitly labels all choices as provisional
expectations.evidence: Output labels choices as provisional multiple times: 'This framework is entirely provisional due to missing context' (line 268), 'Provisional Status Summary' table marks components as 'Provisional' or 'UNKNOWN', and line 269 states 'All metric choices above are conditional'.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions passed. Output successfully avoids prescriptive single-metric recommendation, instead offering multiple conditional frameworks tied to different product goals, with explicit labeling of provisional status and clear documentation of what must be confirmed before proceeding.
